prompt.text: You are about to book a flat in Florence. Write to the owner, Mrs Bianchi: greet her and ask three things about the flat or what is near it.

exercises.correct_answer: Buongiorno, signora Bianchi! Ho bisogno di un appartamento a Firenze. Quante camere ci sono? In bagno c'è la doccia? E c'è una farmacia lì vicino? Grazie!
hints: C'è…? asks if there is one. Quante…? asks how many.
